title: DeMixPert: Decomposed Response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for OOD Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.23114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting transcriptome-wide responses to unseen genetic perturbations remains a major computational challenge because accurate prediction requires recovering both perturbation-specific transcriptional shifts and heterogeneous cellular responses. Existing methods often entangle deterministic response structure with stochastic population-level variation, causing dominant shared patterns to mask weaker perturbation-specific signals and impair distributional modeling. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{DeMixPert}, an approach for Decomposed response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) single-cell Perturbation prediction. DeMixPert decomposes perturbation-induced changes into a basal-state-dependent systematic response, a perturbation-specific response, and population-level variation. translated_title: DeMixPert：基于高斯混合的分解响应建模用于分布外单细胞扰动预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23114v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：预测未见过遗传扰动的全转录组反应仍然是一个主要的计算挑战，因为准确预测需要同时恢复扰动特异性的转录变化和异质性的细胞反应。现有方法常常将确定性的响应结构与随机的群体水平变异纠缠在一起，导致占主导地位的共享模式掩盖了较弱的扰动特异性信号，并损害了分布建模。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了**DeMixPert**，一种用于分布外（OOD）单细胞扰动预测的基于高斯混合的分解响应建模方法。DeMixPert将扰动诱导的变化分解为基础状态依赖的系统性响应、扰动特异性响应和群体水平变异。系统性成分源自对照细胞表达编码的基础状态，而扰动特异性成分则独立建模，从而更好地捕捉未见过扰动的异质性反应。
tldr: DeMixPert通过将单细胞扰动反应分解为基础状态依赖的系统性响应、扰动特异性响应和群体变异三部分，并使用高斯混合建模，解决了现有方法中共享模式掩盖弱扰动信号的问题，从而提升了分布外单细胞扰动预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: DeMixPert decomposes single-cell perturbation responses into basal-state-dependent systematic, perturbation-specific, and population-level variation components using Gaussian mixtures, effectively unmasking weak perturbation signals and improving out-of-distribution prediction accuracy.
